overview: Through thick and thin, Ren Nagase and Kaito Takahashi of King & Prince have always been by each other's side. In Los Angeles, a city full of personal memories for them, the duo set out to celebrate their bond through a uniquely themed adventure. Once inseparable, Ren and Kaito must now part ways to complete a series of challenges before finding their way back to each other. As they navigate the city on their own, the distance reveals new perspectives and deeper feelings. This is the real Ren and Kaito, off-duty and offstage. Join them on their heartfelt journey across the United States and experience the simple joy of finally meeting up again.
title: King & Prince: Our Meet-Up in LA

overview: A few months after *OD Chypre*, the contestants look back on the adventure that changed their lives. Amid shocking revelations, tears, breakups, friendships, and new beginnings, they open up like never before. Through an intimate look at their daily lives, we finally discover what lies behind *Après OD Chypre*.
title: Après OD Chypre

overview: Combining two innovative perspectives – "time within time" and "series within series" – the series tells the story of Leyla, a 28-year-old young and beautiful actress who rapidly climbs the ladder of fame by playing the role assigned to her by the system, but who, under the light of Şule Yüksel Şenler's guidance, discovers her true role and tries to forge her own path.
title: Şule

overview: When Karen moves with her family to Bergen, they are warmly welcomed into the dinner club, a seductive group of friends who fully indulge in an extravagant and hedonistic lifestyle. Until one of the luxurious villas goes up in flames, and their friend Evert is killed. His wife and children barely survive. Karen soon discovers that their close friendship is held together by lies. Everyone has something to hide. Nothing is what it seems. So Karen sets out in search of the truth, but at what cost?
title: De Eetclub
He Gui Mi De Liao Tian Ji Lu Gong Kai Le

overview: Tu Mingyue was born into a wealthy family, but after her father passed away when she was eight, her uncle seized the family fortune and home. She grew up in the countryside with her grandfather. Years later, when her grandfather suffers a heart attack and urgently needs expensive treatment, her uncle offers to cover the medical costs on one condition. She must return to the city and marry Gu Ziyan, her cousin Tu Yanxin's disabled fiancé, in her place. What no one tells her is that Gu Ziyan is actually the mysterious president of the Gu Group and Yancheng's richest man...
title: Don't Mess with the Country Girl

overview: A historical exploration about the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D. and the preserved Roman city it left behind. Tom Hiddleston asks: Could anyone survive Pompeii's final day? Drawing on experts and intuition, he traces real Romans through the eruption.
title: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
Da Hun Dang Ri，Wo Xian Ru Le Xun Huan

overview: Are you ready for the lockdown? Ghost Adventures crew -- Zak Bagans, Aaron Goodwin, Billy Tolley, and Jay Wasley -- is back to investigate the scariest, most notorious, haunted places in the world. The trio will interview eyewitnesses and historians at each location, arming themselves with the stories of the ghosts they will later provoke and confront during their dusk-to-dawn lockdowns. (Note: They don't always come out unscathed!) Then they'll review and analyze their findings with some the most respected experts and specialists in the paranormal field.
title: Ghost Adventures

overview: Each episode spotlights three of the funniest comics delivering sharp, unfiltered takes on culture, family, and real life—from a Hollywood rooftop. The result is a charged, anything-can-happen atmosphere of crowd interactions, celebrity drop-ins, and organic viral moments: a throwback with a fresh point of view, elevating the next wave of comedic voices under the lights of Hollywood.
title: ComicView: Rooftop Series

overview: Raakh is a haunting crime investigation that begins with the disappearance and murder of two teenagers in Delhi. Set in 1978, when such brutality was rare and shocking, the series follows the relentless manhunt launched to track down the killers while exploring the disturbing psyche of the men behind the crime.
title: Raakh

overview: After class placements were decided, the school's two infamous "problem youth" shared not only the same class but the same desk. They're clearly good at studies but pretend to be slackers. Fakers from head to toe, they just keep walking farther down the path of their performance.
title: No.1 Student

overview: Duean Daranphob was called "The Eternal Moon", a young actor who took his own life at just twenty-five. Forty years have passed, but his presence still lingers in the heart of Thai entertainment.
title: Still Holding Up Like The Moon

overview: When Bear and Cho's relationship reached a point of saturation and distance, they agreed to a 30-day period to reflect on their feelings and their future. Sharing memories and talking through their emotional rifts, will the two of them decide to stay together or separate for good?
title: 30 Days of Us

overview: Owner's Manual will test one of the most common divides among man - those who read the owner's manual and those who do not. Representing each side of this divide, Ed Sanders ("Extreme Makeover: Home Edition") and Marcus Hunt (HGTV's "Hammer Heads") are put to the test in a weekly challenge where they attempt to operate today's most advanced, dangerous and powerful machinery and technology - from a stunt plane to an off-road racing car to a locomotive, and more. With opposing points of view and conflicting methods of practice -- one man works strictly from the rule book, while the other uses only his instincts -- the real test will be how this "everyman" duo can collaborate to accomplish their challenge.
title: Owner's Manual

overview: Sitcom about 13-year-old Stanley Brown, who shares his insatiable curiosity about the revolting world around him with a chaotic time-traveller, Archie, and his best friends.
title: The Revolting World of Stanley Brown

overview: Amish Mafia follows those who protect and maintain peace and order within the Amish community.
title: Amish Mafia

overview: The Naturalist follows a brilliant but socially estranged biologist who uses the laws of animal behavior to hunt human predators. The twist is that the protagonist has his own dark secrets, and he turns every case into a study of himself.
title: The Naturalist

overview: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.
title: The D Dorm

overview: Through three crimes that forever changed a nation and football fandom, this docuseries explores the violent "ultras" movement in Spain.
title: Ultras: Passion and Death

overview: In Dungeon Crawler Carl, an alien invasion has wiped out most of humanity and any survivors are forced to fight for their lives on a sadistic intergalactic game show. Sounds bad, right? Now try doing it with bare feet and a stuck-up, self-centered, tiara-wearing talking cat as your partner. Welcome to Dungeon Crawler World: Earth, where the apocalypse will be televised … and Coast Guard vet Carl finds himself stuck with his ex-girlfriend's award-winning show cat, Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk, as they try to survive the end of the world, fighting monsters, aliens, an insane A.I. and even other survivors … all for the sake of good TV. Survival is optional. Entertainment is not.
title: Dungeon Crawler Carl

overview: Alex, a 24-year-old young woman, decides to drop her studies to launch, with her best friend Romain, her own influencer agency. Called "Followers Agency", this company manages to gain popularity and becomes a reference for young influencers. However, this success arouses jealousy among his competitors and Alex has to face his rivals, Michaël from "Celebrity Factory" and Sandra, host of the show "Sandra Confidential". Alex's life is turned upside down when she is the victim of a mysterious car accident and falls into a coma. His prognosis is then engaged and the future of "Followers Agencers" is threatened.
title: Influences

overview: Love. Betrayal. Drama. Getting what you want out of life isn't easy - especially while using a wheelchair. This season, Auti finds herself embroiled in conflict as her marriage and friendships unravel. Tiphany falls in love and begins a search for her missing sister. Mia confronts emotional demons while jumping back into dating. Angela shifts her modeling career into high gear and takes new steps toward independence. Chelsie experiences extreme highs and lows with home life and rehabilitation.
title: Push Girls

overview: A mysterious aristocrat works as a private detective purely for pleasure, bringing an unprecedented twist to the mystery genre: he solves complex cases without ever conducting investigations himself. Instead, he relies entirely on his loyal team of subordinates to do the legwork while he focuses on entertaining the ladies.
title: Kizoku Tantei

overview: A great open conversation between Aquiribeiro, Bruno Alcantara, and Crônicas de Jorge, where the three friends talk about everyday situations and everything happening on the internet.
title: Cortina De Fumaça

overview: An abandoned single mother of three falls in love with a dying, amnesiac young man. Taking advantage of his memory loss, she names him "Hoshio" and convinces him that he is their father. As they build a life together, Hoshio slowly regains feelings for her while exhibiting mysterious, otherworldly abilities.
title: Starman: Kono Hoshi no Koi

overview: A sluggish, aloof, yet exceptionally talented private forensic investigator uses cutting-edge science, DNA testing, and data analysis to solve trivial civil cases and uncover conclusive evidence for the disadvantaged, tackling trivial mysteries that the police and the legal system overlook.
title: Smoking Gun

overview: Heaven's Rock follows the members of a popular rock band and their rival who all die in an unexpected accident. To earn their second chance at life, they must work together and complete various bizarre tasks assigned to them by a shinigami.
title: Heaven's Rock

overview: A hilarious game is initiated between four quirky roommates in a luxury Aoyama apartment. They are tasked to compete against one another through a series of eccentric challenges; the ultimate winner earns full, permanent ownership of the coveted home.
title: Room of King

overview: Shinigami no Ballad primarily centers around a young-looking girl named Momo who is a shinigami, or death god. Momo is clad in all white, along with having long white hair, and as a god of death, she leads deceased souls to the other side. She carries with her a large scythe and an ID card which helps to facilitate in her identification as a shinigami; her shinigami ID number is A-100100. Momo is different from other shinigami because she tries to ease the suffering of the people she encounters whether they be living or already dead, such as conversing messages from the dead to the living. She is also known to cry a lot, and she says that she cries for the dead because they no longer can. Accompanying Momo is a talking black cat familiar named Daniel (Ai Yoshikawa) with a bell around his neck and bat-like wings who helps Momo out. The living frequently hear the ringing of Daniel's bell when Momo and Daniel are nearby. Daniel has a calm character and does not show as much sympathy to humans as Momo, but is still patient with them. In the TV drama, Daniel is portrayed as a young boy rather than a cat. The story follows Momo and Daniel as they interact with the living and usually consists of them changing something sorrowful for the living.
title: Shinigami no Ballad

overview: It's been two years since Douji became deaf and lost the purpose in his life One evening when he goes to the club where his big brother works, he meets a dancing boys team and finds out that even if he can't hear what people say he can still feel the music's vibrations and dance Then he decides to join the dancing team and soon discovers a whole new world.
title: Sign

overview: Katsuhiro Tamura and Misuzu Sumiyoshi are employees of a legal document firm. They have very different personalities and don't always get along well, but gradually develop good relations while working together on various legal cases.
title: Tokujo Kabachi!!

overview: NAOTO has been part of EXILE and Sandaime J Soul Brothers for years, but his job in these groups is a cover for his true job. He is actually a hero that protects society from bad people. He doesn't want to be discovered by the other members, though, because he doesn't want to cause them trouble.
title: Night Hero NAOTO

overview: Play School is a British children's television series produced by the BBC which ran from 21 April 1964 until 14 October 1988.
title: Play School

overview: An unpopular fashion model suddenly develops a supernatural ability to see murder scenes before they happen. She teams up with a suspended detective to use her unique "VISION" to solve difficult crimes while unraveling the dark secrets hidden in her own past.
title: Vision: Koroshi ga Mieru Onna

overview: Misako Ayukawa, a woman in her 30s, is an English teacher with ironically poor English skills. She values herself over her students and money over love. She displays arrogance in front of her students, but acts pleasantly around everyone else. However, Ayukawa possesses a brilliant mind for solving puzzles. Motivated by the possibility of rewards and treasure, she ends up tackling various cases on the weekends along with 3 of her top students.
title: Puzzle

overview: Meisuke Nueno is the homeroom teacher of a 2nd grade 3 class in high school. He is referred to as Nube. He sometimes carries himself as an idiot, but he does care about his students a lot. He also has a hidden side. Meisuke Nueno has a demon's hand. He solves monstrous case and fights desperately to save students from monsters.
title: Jigoku Sensei Nube

overview: Onna wa Sore wo Yurusanai follows a traumatized rookie lawyer who made a devastating mistake in her first trial and a disgraced, fallen elite attorney as they team up to take on difficult, socially conscious case
title: Onna wa Sore wo Yurusanai

overview: An eccentric, elite-track rookie policer officer and a martial-arts-trained handsome detective are partnered to solve difficult criminal cases. Shoved aside and frequently scolded by veteran detectives, the duo works together as a team to tackle baffling mysteries and save the day.
title: Senryokugai Sōsakan

overview: Kaitō Royale follows a group of amnesic thieves who are brought together by a mysterious woman. Tasked with pulling off dangerous heists, they must cooperate to steal prized treasures and recover their lost memories
title: Kaitō Royale

overview: Suzuki, an eccentric researcher at a university hospital, develops a groundbreaking anticancer drug that halts the self-renewal of cancer stem cells. However, his colleagues dismiss his discovery, and he's denied approval for human trials. Desperate, he meets Manami, a terminal cancer patient, and with her help, conducts a clinical trial. But things take an unexpected turn. What will become of Suzuki, Manami, and the new drug? What consequences await as Pandora's box is opened?
title: Pandora

overview: Triangle starts with the murder of a 10-year-old girl in 1984. 15 years later, after the case goes unsolved and passes the statute of limitations, a doctor named Goda Ryoji suddenly quits from his hospital and eventually becomes a detective. In 2008, he meets Sachi, a traveling artist in Paris, and shortly after Goda's return to Japan, he becomes involved in the expired murder case when another detective receives an anonymous phone call.
title: Triangle

overview: In the year 2141, terrorists travel back to 2012 to assassinate a key ancestor, prompting the future government to warn 2012 authorities. To stop the plot, a special task force—whose name references "out-of-place artifacts"—is recruited to locate and neutralize the timeline-altering assassins before history is rewritten.
title: O-PARTS

overview: The life of Fermín, a young and attractive priest from the village of La Isleta, becomes complicated when his cousin Isaac and his wife, Ana, move there. He is almost immediately drawn to Ana. When he discovers that she harbors the same feelings, a fierce inner struggle erupts. Ana, for her part, feels an unpayable debt to Isaac for having rescued her from her difficult and tragic past, and she too must confront the nightmare of having to sacrifice her own happiness out of loyalty.
title: Ella, maldita alma

overview: Quest brings you "Inventions That Rocked the World". Technical innovations and inventions have shaped the world of popular music through the decades. From drum machines to downloads this series features archive footage of artists, engineers and producers who used them. They are bought to life by the big hits of the time that quite literally, rocked our world and forever changed our relationship with music. Through sensational clips, expert interviews from artists such as Moby and Gary Numan and a sound track provided by the titans of rock ‘n' roll we explore the ingenious inventions that changed contemporary music, shaped popular culture and rewrote social history. All brought together by narration from British music legend Suggs.
title: Inventions That Rocked the World

overview: Sanada Kohei is in his third year of junior high school, and is constantly bullied by three classmates, one of which happens to like the same girl that he does. Along with a troubled school life, Kohei doesn't get very good grades and his family life isn't too great either. The only company he keeps is that of flowers, and he has many potted flowers in his room that he takes care of. Kohei has already gone through ten tutors by the time that the drama takes place. Hip-hop singer ZEEBRA plays Shunsaku, his newest tutor. Shunsaku is not the usual kind of tutor; he's a bit perverted and throws Kohei around when he's being difficult. Ultimately, it's Shunsaku's influence that changes Kohei.
title: 15-sai no Blues

overview: Kirishima, a skilled plastic surgeon who previously used to work for the US ‘Federal Witness Protection Programme'. His nickname is "Face Maker." Patients come to him seeking to change their lives, and he grants them that wish with a new face. He doesn't take money but asks for his patients' previous faces as a payment. How would you feel if you encountered someone with your former face?
title: Face Maker

overview: When a cowardly first-grader puts on his late mother's glasses, her ghost—a former passionate police officer—appears to him, prompting the unlikely mother-son duo to team up, solve local crimes, and help restless spirits resolve their earthly regrets before her final farewell.
title: Ghost Mama Sousasen

overview: Aiba Tsubasa has astounding mathematical powers. He has two younger brothers: Riku, a naive but kind-hearted university student, and Umi, who was born with a weak heart and has no way to be saved except through an organ transplant. In order to help Umi, their mother Takako, a gifted surgeon, had left Tsubasa and Riku who were still very young and sought refuge with a medical research facility. The facility is a shadowy organization which studies people with phenomenal powers in specific areas and repeatedly conducts unethical human experiments in an attempt to create scientifically superior humans. As time goes by, Umi has a successful transplant surgery. Tsubasa and Riku desperately try to protect their younger brother, who has slipped out of the facility to seek their help.
title: Fallen Angel

overview: Natsuki Morishita suddenly lost his parents when he was young. After that, he lived at his relative's home, but he wasn't happy living there and he ran away. Natsuki then lived on the streets of the big city. Through a lot of struggles, Natsuki is finally able to open a small store. His childhood friend Wataru Okajima then appears in front of him. Natsuki Morishita and Wataru Okajima get swept up by friendship, betrayal and desires.
title: Frenemy: Rumble of the Rat

overview: An unconventional, brilliant assistant inspector ignores hierarchy and her exasperated superiors to solve "perfect murders" using unorthodox methods in a reverse whodunit drama.
title: Fukuie Keibuho no Aisatsu

overview: A brilliant general medicine doctor, who secretly dreams of becoming a famous dancer, returns to Japan to launch his entertainment career. After being scammed by a fake agency, he stays in the country, taking a part-time job at a run-down clinic to solve medical mysteries while plotting his dance comeback.
title: GM Odore Doctor

overview: Freeter, Ie wo Kau follows Seiji Take, a 25-year-old with no ambition or savings who quits his job after three months. Following his mother's sudden depression, he takes on manual labor jobs to buy a house, striving to rebuild his family's life and his own self-worth.
title: Freeter, Ie wo Kau

overview: Beginners! follows a group of eccentric, troubled students who enter a rigorous police academy.
title: Beginners!

overview: The story revolves around high school student Akira Uehara, sensitive and demure by nature. Despite that he has a large crush on the most feared and violent girl in school–Nanako Momoi, who seems fragile and cute, until she opens her mouth. One day, Uehara is made to go to Momoi's house where he meets her mad scientist grandfather and unwillingly becomes the test subject for one of his machines. Accidentally, Momoi also gets tangled in the experiment and the two end up switching bodies. To make matters worse Momoi in Uehara's body breaks the machine (which will cost 2mil. yen to fix) as she would like more time in this body thus beginning their world full of debts and troubles.
title: Boku to Kanojo no XXX

overview: A light-hearted exploration of maths and science, presented by Johnny Ball.
title: Think of a Number

overview: When a food-loving fashion model and a sauna-obsessed hair stylist with opposite personalities take weekend trips across Japan, their shared journeys through private saunas and gourmet meals become the ultimate remedy for the stresses of modern adult life.
title: Kara-chan & Shitō-san &,

overview: Tamami Odate, a determined and skilled forensic doctor known as the "Bull Doctor," relentlessly uncovers the hidden truths behind unexplained deaths. As a dedicated single mother, her fierce persistence leads to frequent clashes with passionate detectives and colleagues over conflicting medical interpretations of the cases.
title: Bull Doctor

overview: Tamaki, a young girl who lives with her motorcycle cop brother, has got a job at a travel agency after months of searching. The most important person in her department is the popular tour conductor Mikio, but her supervisor is the ex-flight attendant Sayori, whose last name happens to be Tamaki. Tamaki's first job is to hand out pocket tissues on the street, and she strikes up an acquaintance with Yajima, another tissue peddler who works for DoCoMo. Drama develops when the two Tamakis fall victim to a mixup in cell phones.
title: Chance!

overview: Daisuki!! follows Yuzu Fukuhara, a 23-year-old woman with an intellectual disability, as she bravely navigates motherhood after the tragic loss of her boyfriend.
title: Daisuki!!

overview: Fuyu no Sakura tells a pure romance story of a gentle, inexperienced glass craftsman in Yamagata who rescues a married woman visiting from Tokyo after a car accident, eventually sparking an unexpected, profound love affair.
title: Fuyu no Sakura

overview: Unsuspecting young adults are thrust into a forced, psychological death game for an unknown, sinister purpose. Trapped and unable to call for help, participants use their wits, strength, and instincts to survive deadly challenges. They must navigate the park, outsmart the competition, and find a way to escape alive.
title: Death Game Park

overview: Giragira depicts the life of a married man Nanase Kohei after he returned to his former job as a male host. He woos the clients with his gentle and caring nature, and soon retrieves his former credit as the ace of the club. However, the transition back for this middle-aged man is not without its challenges. Afraid that his wife will find out about this job, Nanase is also garnering jealousy and displeasure from the younger hosts. Throughout the course of his employment, he demonstrates to others that hosting should not be the vulgar occupation it has become where the entire goal is to make the women frivolously spend money, rather, it is about a human connection that is so often overlooked.
title: Giragira

overview: The show focuses on contestants navigating attraction regardless of gender, promising high-stakes drama, secret voting, and strategic romance.
title: Stand BI Me

overview: The story follows Bunta, who has lost his job and family, as he joins a mysterious company called Nonamare. He is tasked with using small, seemingly trivial supernatural abilities to save the world. A core rule of his employment is that he cannot fall in love. He lives with a woman named Shiki who has lost her memory and believes they are married. The series moves from a comedic tone in the first half to a more serious tone in the second half.
title: Just a bit Espers

overview: Donal Macintyre revisits so-called 'Cold cases' that have never been closed to see if he and his team of experts can uncover details in the case that were maybe missed the first time around.
title: Donal Macintyre: Unsolved

overview: Love Actually observes a group of over 30-years-old men and women going through a match-making love journey.
title: Love Actually

overview: Yes, I Do is dedicated to showing the audience a real and pure view of love and the most beautiful moments in relationships. In the "Love House," several spaces are created to imitate realistic and high-end love scenes. The eight male and female guests, who are good-looking, clever and good at handling worldly affairs, live in the Love House without a script. They start ordinary and real love stories of urban young people. The shooting of the new-type sweet love variety show promotes the relationships like an idol drama, making the audience feel like watching idol dramas.
title: Yes, I Do

overview: The series follows Shibata Ichiha, an editor for a publishing company who is struggling in her work and love life. She begins ghostwriting a love advice column for a former model, which leads her to seek advice from Shido Tsukasa, an eccentric associate professor who studies animal courtship behavior. Through the lens of how animals find mates, the characters navigate their own complex relationships, offering insights into human happiness.
title: We are Worse at Love Than Pandas

overview: The Faceless Patient follows a surgeon whose kidnapped wife is held hostage by a blackmailer. He is forced into an impossible medical dilemma: either kill an anonymous, disfigured fugitive patient on the operating table, or his wife dies.
title: The Faceless Patient

overview: Coverage of the World Touring Car Championships.
title: World Touring Car Championship Highlights

overview: Kotaro Sakabe and his friends Rin and Hayato are suddenly transported seven years into the past, where they rescue Shiori Okuma—the prime suspect in the "Serial Teacher Murder Case." As murders continue, the trio must decide: is Shiori a killer or a falsely accused victim?
title: Kimi ga Shikei ni Naru Mae ni

overview: A new general manager has to reform a failing baseball team, even if that means making controversial changes.
title: Stove League

overview: Sirius no Hansho follows attorney Shota Fujishima as he tackles an impregnable retrial request to overturn the wrongful conviction of a death row inmate for a brutal 25-year-old family murder.
title: Sirius no Hansho

overview: P.P.O.I. follows a short, feminine-looking 3rd-year junior high student and his highly popular best friend as they navigate school life, forming a love triangle, dealing with teenage insecurities, and embarking on coming-of-age adventures together.
title: P.P.O.I.

overview: A timid, kind-hearted, and unemployed university graduate constantly finds himself dragged into dangerous and bizarre crime cases by his opportunistic childhood friend, forcing him to grow as he resolves each incident in this lighthearted mystery-comedy.
title: Shirato Osamu no Jikenbo
